objects.name: Analytic 2251
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Virtual Network Computing (VNC) or proprietary remote console sessions to embedded Human-Machine Interface (HMI) panels or operator terminals from IP addresses outside the approved Network Management System (NMS) Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) subnet, where the sessions access Industrial Control System (ICS) control interfaces with physical-plant impact. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
